title: Arachne Viewpoint MCP Integration Document

server_info.name: arachne-viewpoint-mcp
server_info.description: Robot viewpoint planning and viewpoint-acquire capture chain exposure. Read-only planning is safe to hand to any agent; execution moves the real arm and must be restricted.
server_info.availability: Opt-in. Started from teach_panel GUI button 'MCP Servers' or ros2 launch arachne_mcp mcp_servers.launch.py

token_env_vars.ARACHNE_MCP_PLANNER_TOKEN: planner-only token, safe to distribute to agents
token_env_vars.ARACHNE_MCP_EXECUTION_TOKEN: execution token, RESTRICTED - can move the robot arm

motion_gate.detail: acquire_chain only moves the arm when both mcp_motion_enabled:=true AND mcp_confirm_agent_motion:=true are set on the launch command. Requires an explicit operator decision.

rules: Do not log or commit tokens.
Planner capability is read-only and never moves the arm.
Every acquire_chain call that actually runs implies arm motion between viewpoints.
Use cancel_acquire to stop an in-flight chain at any time.
GET /health is the ONLY token-free endpoint; it reports liveness only (see health_probe below) and never exposes capability, state or data.

health_probe.purpose: Token-free liveness probe: answers whether the MCP listener is up. HTTP 200 with body {"status":"ok","service":"arachne_mcp"} for the aggregate server (standalone debug servers report their own service names). Connection refused/timeout means the MCP process is not running. Placed outside the bearer guard; it carries no capability, no state and no data, so guarded paths and their auth are unaffected.

mcp_streamable_http.description: Model Context Protocol over Streamable HTTP (JSON-RPC). Use these URLs as-is when configuring an MCP client (Claude Desktop, opencode, custom agent).

plain_json_http.description: Same five capabilities exposed as plain JSON endpoints for agents without MCP support. Request body = tool argument object; response body = {'ok': true|false, 'result': <tool output> | 'error': '<reason>'}. Same bearer-token split as the MCP paths.

http_status_semantics.400: bad arguments or malformed JSON body
http_status_semantics.404: unknown path or plan_id not found

tools.name: plan_viewpoints
tools.summary: Sample candidate viewpoints around a target position and persist the filtered result to the shared plan directory. Never moves anything.

target_xyz.description: Target position in base_link frame [x, y, z] meters.

up_vector.description: Sampling-sphere reference axis in base_link frame (default [0,0,1]).

output_summary.plan_id: id string, required by list_reachable_viewpoints / acquire_chain
output_summary.plan_file: absolute path of the persisted plan file

tools.name: list_reachable_viewpoints
tools.summary: Return only the ik-reachable && collision-free viewpoints of a stored plan, indexed for use by acquire_chain.

reachable_viewpoints.index: position inside the filtered list - pass this to acquire_chain indices

tools.name: acquire_chain
tools.summary: Asynchronously move the arm through selected viewpoints of a stored plan and capture RGB/depth/cloud at each. Returns immediately; poll get_acquire_status.
tools.preconditions: launch flags mcp_motion_enabled:=true and mcp_confirm_agent_motion:=true must be set; otherwise rejected and nothing moves

indices.description: 'all' or positions inside the FILTERED reachable list returned by list_reachable_viewpoints.

output_summary.success: true means accepted and running asynchronously; false means rejected (gate/busy/bad plan/max points) with 'message' explaining why
output_summary.run_id: batch id used to correlate status results
output_summary.run_dir: absolute output directory containing manifest.json and per-index captures
output_summary.num_viewpoints: number of points in this run

tools.name: get_acquire_status
tools.summary: Poll the running or last acquire chain. Call after every acquire_chain until busy=false.

output_summary.finished_stamp: ISO timestamp or null while running

tools.name: cancel_acquire
tools.summary: Safely stop a running chain: interrupts in-flight motion (SDK stopJoint + zero velocity stream) and finalizes the manifest. Safe to call any time.

output_summary.success: false if no active chain existed

recommended_agent_flow: 3. if motion is authorized: call acquire_chain(plan_id, indices=[...]) -> run_id
4. poll get_acquire_status() until busy=false -> per-point ok/path results
5. optionally cancel_acquire() to abort early or release a stuck chain
